changes: FIX-01: Primary paper PMC3232990 explicitly states autopsy was delayed 5 days so exact cause of death could not be conclusively determined by autopsy alone, and 'the liver damage was mild and could not be the only explanation for the sudden death' (microscopy showed moderate centrolobular liver necrosis, severe colonic mucosal/submucosal necrosis, and probable acute cardiac insufficiency/acidosis). Saying '解剖確認死因為急性肝臟壞死' / '因急性肝壞死猝逝' directly contradicts the source. → Revise S15 summary, K151-0304, and chapters[1] to accurately report: although the 5-day-delayed autopsy could not alone establish a single definitive cause of death (noting mild-to-moderate liver necrosis alongside severe colonic mucosal necrosis and suspected acidosis-linked cardiac arrest), finding 9.5×10^7 CFU/g B. cereus and 14.8 μg/g cereulide in the pasta led the investigators to conclude B. cereus food poisoning was the most likely cause of death.

FIX-02: Uncritically propagates an internal arithmetic error from PMC9957224's Discussion section claiming 88.31% ('八成八') of 77 Polish domestic refrigerators exceeded 4°C. Verification of PMC9957224 Table 1 and Appendix A Table A1 proves only 53/77 = 68.83% exceeded 4.0°C (whereas 68/77 = 88.31% exceeded 2.0°C). → Replace '88.31% 超過 4°C' / '八成八超過 4 度' with the verified empirical Table 1 / Table A1 figure '68.8%（53/77 台，約近七成）平均超過 4°C' (keeping the verified '49.35% 超過 5°C', '3.9% 超過 10°C', mean '5.1°C', max '15.2°C'), and document the original paper's Discussion-section arithmetic typo in S24 limitations.

FIX-03: Mistranslates 'zucchini' (official HK CFS Chinese Report No. 66 calls it '翠玉瓜') as '節瓜' (which is fuzzy melon / Benincasa hispida var. chieh-qua, a different species); S01 locator also cites nonexistent 'Tables 2–5' (actual report has Table 1, Table 2, Figures 2–5, Annexes I–VI). → Replace '節瓜' with Taiwan-standard '櫛瓜'（可括註香港報告原稱「翠玉瓜」）across S01, K151-0301, and chapters[0]; fix S01 locator to 'HK CFS Risk Assessment Studies Report No. 66 (June 2022), Executive Summary, Table 1, Table 2, Figures 2–5, Annexes III–VI'.

FIX-04: Cites '41–47°C' and '7.1–10 分鐘' doubling time attributed to S20 (PMC4920134), but neither S20 (which states only '~10 minutes') nor S14 (which states '12 to 50°C and 8 to 10 min') mentions '7.1' minutes or '41–47°C'. → Align S20 summary, K151-0308, and chapters[2] to the exact verified values in S14 and S20 ('12–50°C' 生長區間與 '8–10 分鐘'／約 10 分鐘翻倍), or attach a verified primary source explicitly stating 41–47°C and 7.1 min.

FIX-05: Zero 【換算】 tags appear in the file despite imperial-to-metric conversions from US-only °F pages (USDA S06: 40°F->4.4°C, 90°F->32.2°C, 165°F->73.9°C; FDA S07: 0°F->-18°C); also K151-0310 & chapters[3] assert '不到新台幣兩毛錢' without stating the assumed residential kWh tariff (0.043 kWh × NT$3–4/kWh = NT$0.13–0.17, whereas top summer tier NT$6–8/kWh reaches ~NT$0.26–0.35). → Add explicit 【換算】 tags to °F->°C conversions sourced from USDA S06 / FDA S07 (4.4°C、32.2°C、73.9°C、-18°C), and state the assumed Taiwan ordinary residential tariff (~每度 3–4 元) in K151-0310 & chapters[3] when stating '不到新台幣兩毛錢'.

FIX-06: Viewer-facing questions contain absolute safety wording ('才萬無一失' and '零風險吃法'), which conflicts with food-safety editorial guidance against promising 100% risk elimination. → Soften '才萬無一失' to '才最安全安心' and '零風險吃法' to '最安全省心的吃法' (or '大幅降低風險的吃法').

FIX-07: Minor primary-source fidelity, attribution, and clustering items: (a) S15 & S16 belong to the same Belgian cereulide co-author network (Rajkovic/Andjelkovic + Delbrassinne/Mahillon); (b) S19 limitations mislabels RPLA as '酵素免疫分析法' (ELISA); (c) S21 abstract reports plastic-vs-metal was correlated/confounded with depth rather than proven independently; (d) K151-0303 attributes 25%/20%/70–80% saliva figures jointly to EFSA 2017 (S04) whereas those figures are in HK CFS S01 (citing EFSA 2008/JECFA); (e) K151-0303/chapters[0] can state more cleanly that S23's 8×/60×/140× jump is vitamin C reversing from inhibitor to promoter in 10% lipid; (f) S14 limitations should note Japanese C. perfringens outbreaks occurred mainly in large cooking facilities (few in homes); (g) S08 locator headings should be 'Milk / Rice / Meat'; (h) acknowledge adjacency with G791 cards K146-0309 & K146-0315. → Unify S15 & S16 network label as Belgian cereulide co-author cluster; fix S19 method to '反向被動乳膠凝集法（RPLA）'; soften S21/K151-0314 material attribution to note correlation with depth alongside higher metal conductivity; attribute 25%/20%/70–80% saliva stats to S01 (citing EFSA 2008/JECFA); sharpen S23 reversal phrasing; note S14 commercial-facility predominance; fix S08 locator headings; add K146-0309 & K146-0315 boundary note in X151R3-NA01.

changes: FIX-01: 標題與問題宣稱「美、歐、加、日四國標準竟然差了十倍」，但數學與法規定義均不成立：加拿大烘焙豆 ≤0.1% 係按豆重計（對 1.0–1.2% 阿拉比卡豆約相當於去除 90–92%），加拿大與歐盟即溶標準皆為 ≤0.3%（相同），日本 ≥90% 去除（殘留 ≤10%）與美國約 97% 去除（殘留 ~3%）差距為 ~3.3 倍，並無「十倍」差距。 → 將「竟然差了十倍」／「四國標準差十倍」改為準確表述（例如「各國低因標準寬嚴竟差好幾倍？」／「四國標準各算各的」），並在 K151-0407.answer_target 補一句點明加拿大 0.1% 係按豆重計算（非去除 99.9%）。

FIX-02: 引用 Olechno et al. (2021, PMC8228209) Section 2.3 的「20 °C 溶解度 1.46 mg/mL」屬上游論文十倍小數點筆誤（咖啡因常溫水溶解度實約 16 mg/mL［20 °C］至 21.6 mg/mL［25 °C］，連該論文 Table 1 常溫冷萃都實測達 1.962 mg/mL）。 → 自 K151-0412 與 S24.summary 移除「20 °C 只有 1.46 mg/mL」錯誤數值，改以熱水（80 °C 180 mg/mL、100 °C 670 mg/mL）大幅加速咖啡因溶出動力學表述（若要保留常溫值須另補 PubChem/Merck 一手來源並標 25 °C 約 21.6 mg/mL），並於 S24.limitations 註記上游 20 °C 筆誤。
FIX-03: 將 JAMA 2006（X151R4-S14）的慢代謝比例誇大寫成「受試者裡有超過五成五屬於『慢代謝體質』」，但原始研究為病例組 55%（1,114/2,014）、對照組 54%（1,082/2,014），整體合併為 54.52%（未超過 55%）。 → 比照 K151-0404，改寫為「受試者裡有超過一半（約 54% 至 55%）屬於『慢代謝體質』」。

FIX-04: X151R4-S11 聲明僅閱讀 PubMed 摘要（Abstract），但內文卻引述摘要未出現的「僅 1 件未檢出」「10 家低因有 9 家驗出殘留」細部計數，構成出處範圍不符。 → 二擇一：（A）直接取得並核對 J Anal Toxicol 2006;30(8):611-613 原文 Table I 後更新 read_via 與 locator；或（B）嚴守 PubMed 摘要可驗證範圍，改寫為「10 家不同店家的 16 盎司低因咖啡實測介於 0 至 13.9 毫克，多數含可測得殘留」。

FIX-05: 跨池重疊聲明漏列三處既有條目：G678 內含已入選卡 K92-023（咖啡因阻斷腺苷疲勞分子）、既有義式高壓與深淺焙孔隙題案 G671（含 K90-011）與咖啡水溫題 G614、以及整併 G411 的蜜蜂咖啡因長片題案 G583。 → 在 X151R4-NA01 與 K151-0401.notes 補記 K92-023 並寫明區隔角度；在 X151R4-NA03 的 existing_ids 補入 ["G671", "K90-011", "G614"]；在 X151R4-NA02 補入 "G583"；並於 theme.drop_if 同步更新。

FIX-06: 多項次要精準度與標註修正：（1）S05/S06 應同屬 EU 官方網路；（2）K151-0406「翻倍、拉長約 5 至 10 小時」具歧義且 visual「約 10 小時」缺【推算】；（3）K151-0408 的「約 473 mL」「逾五倍」及 visual「6–31.6 mg」缺【換算】，且「5–10 杯 60–139 mg」宜註明採 12–13.9 mg/杯計；（4）K151-0417 與第 6 章「冷水洗臉」在廣島大學摘要僅為「洗臉（face washing）」；（5）第 3 章「美國食藥局」宜統一為「美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）」或「美國 FDA」；（6）S23（Foods 2020）明述類黑精主導褐色、風味與抗氧化力而非專論苦味。 → 逐項補齊【換算】／【推算】標籤、統一美國 FDA 譯名、將「冷水洗臉」改為「洗臉」、釐清口服避孕藥半衰期為「翻倍（由平均 5 小時拉長至約 10 小時【推算】）」，並微調 S23 歸因與 EU 網路欄位。
